title: EthosGPT: Mapping Human Value Diversity to Advance Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
benchmark_measurement: Measurement of the importance of God and religious faith as components of the 'Traditional vs. Secular-Rational Values' cultural dimension, based on questions from the World Values Survey.
findings: The LLM's ability to model the 'Traditional vs. Secular-Rational' value dimension, which includes attitudes toward religion, varies significantly across different cultural-religious regions. The model showed poor alignment for the Confucian region on this axis and variable performance for regions defined by religious heritage like Protestant Europe, Catholic Europe, Orthodox Europe, and African-Islamic regions. This indicates uneven generalization of cultural values related to religion and secularism.
